title: If I Could Reach You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Uta lives with her older brother and his new wife Kaoru, a childhood friend on whom Uta has long had a crush. Trying to get over her feelings, Uta is drawn closer as cracks appear in the marriage and Kaoru confides in her; the series follows Uta's coming to terms with her sexuality (Kodansha blurb; Wikipedia; AniList).
life_message: Facing one's feelings honestly, even unreturned ones, is part of growing up and finding self-worth.

content.note: None noted; MU 'Accident/s' and 'Injury' low votes (to verify).
Teen's same-sex crush on her adult sister-in-law; age gap (AniList Age Gap; MU Student-Adult Relationship). Physical content not described (to verify).
Uta feels a burden due to her mother's verbal abuse (Wikipedia); marriage breakdown (MU Divorce, Cheating low votes).
